description: Ding, Yu and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The source describes hourly wind-speed means and standard deviations from 120 turbines across 2009–2010. Missing values are imputed using an iterative singular-value-decomposition procedure. Coordinates are transformed while preserving relative distances. These processed fields support wind-energy spatial and temporal modelling; they are not an untouched raw sensor feed. Original geography, stationarity and imputation performance beyond the described collection are not inferred. The file archive is recorded without opening its data. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
